why: Week-1 data (Nov 1-7): the 119 s LODESTONE film reached 340 with 42% skips and 24 s avg watch; every short (cuts, game, reveal, fact) reached 126-168 with 58-71% skips and 4-8 s watch. Shorts open on still text cards; the film opens on an animated device. v4: keep films ~90 s (question in 10 s), moving openers on shorts, reveal becomes a full fact short. Game #2 got the first game comment (answer held back) - keep.
owner_note: The performance-analyst may change anything in 'tunable' (one change per version, see .claude/agents/performance-analyst.md). Nothing in 'locked' may change without Jazzy.

hook.rule: Open on the device doing the impossible thing (or the strangest true fact), in big text from frame 0. No context before it.
hook.first_frame: Frame 0 shows the hook text and the device; it is the cover.

structure.note: a subject + the impossible claim, <= 10 words, problem or device first (learnings rule 2)
the stakes/question line inside the first 10 s (learnings rule 1)
ONE dated, sourced beat
fictional program name + 1 spec line
3 trials, fast, escalating numbers
catch + stamp moment
pull-back + 'Next case Sunday. Follow @compandgrow.'

cutdowns.rule: Each cut opens on its own hook in the first 3 s; never open a cut on a slow line or a title card.

style.rule: Alternate a test style every other film (2D styles only, ~45 min render on 2 cores). After 2 tests per style keep the winner as the anchor; drop styles that lose twice.

caption.first_line: the hook or the comment question, <= 10 words

posting.note: v4 test (Nov 15-28): Wed + Sat engineering brain tests; real-or-fake game paused; Sat film cut dropped. Post the brain-test answer as a pinned comment the next day (or in the next day's caption if pinning isn't possible via Zernio).

times.note: daily; one post per day from Nov 15. Extra 10:28 posts allowed while testing.

game.name: real_or_fake

structure.note: 'One of these is real.' + 3 numbered devices on screen from frame 0
3 device cards, ~4 s each: name, one-line claim, one number. One is a real, sourced invention/patent/experiment; two come from our fictional programs
countdown 3-2-1 + 'Comment 1, 2 or 3' (~3 s)
REAL stamp on the true one with year + source line; FAKE stamps on the others naming the film they come from
'FULL BRIEFINGS on @compandgrow'

game.rules: The real device must be in a FACTS.md with source + quote. The fake ones are labelled FAKE at the reveal. Caption first line = the question; never give the answer in the caption.
game.judge: comments, shares+saves and follows per 1k reach vs the normal cuts, after 3 game Reels
game.answer: HELD BACK: the game ends on 'ANSWER TOMORROW' + follow card; the next day's reveal Reel (cards kit mode 'reveal') gives the answer. Caption never gives the answer.

fact.name: Sounds fake. It's real.

structure.note: the unbelievable true claim in big text from frame 0, <= 8 words
2-4 cards: one line + one number each, ~3.5 s
the twist or the strongest fact + source line
follow card

fact.rules: 100% true and sourced in FACTS.md (2 sources or 1 primary). Pick stories with a 'no way' reaction: odd WWII/Cold War engineering, lab science that sounds like sci-fi, failed megaprojects, record machines. Never-list applies.
fact.opener: Frame 0 moves: kit hook scene has rotating rays, drifting specks, icon push-in and a text punch (studio/kits/cards fx). Never open on a still card.

tunable.follow_cta: Every Reel ends on a follow card ('FOLLOW @compandgrow' + why: next case / new round / new one every week). Captions end with a follow line.
tunable.trial_reels: Not used while the account has < 500 followers: almost all viewers are already non-followers.

reveal.name: answer as a story
reveal.rule: The day after a game, post a full 'Sounds fake. It's real.' short about the REAL item (works on its own); first card says 'Yesterday's game: #N was real.' Fake items are named in the caption with the briefing they come from. No standalone stamp-only reveal Reels.

brain_test.name: Engineering brain test
types: focus: which way does the last gear turn (chain of 5-9 gears)
memory: memorise a control panel 3 s, which switch changed
calc: simple pulley/lever/gear-ratio sum with a timer
track: follow the ball through pipes, which exit

structure.note: frame 0 = the puzzle title + 'Only 10% get this' style hook, moving
the test itself with a visible countdown timer
'Comment your answer' + 3-2-1
'Answer in the pinned comment / tomorrow · FOLLOW for the next test'

brain_test.rules: Exactly one correct answer, computed in code and stated in FACTS.md (answer + working). No trick wording. Engineering visuals only (gears, pulleys, pipes, panels) so the audience matches the films. Never give the answer in the caption.
brain_test.judge: replays, comments, avg watch ratio and shares vs the real-or-fake games after 4 brain tests (2 weeks)

locked.facts: Every real-world claim is sourced in the film's FACTS.md (claim -> URL). The fictional program, specs and trials are invented and never attributed to real agencies, labs or people.
locked.never_list: plan/CONTENT_PLAN.md -> Never: real health/vaccine claims, real elections, real disasters blamed on a device, real named people as villains, club/brand logos.
locked.visuals: No logos, no player/celebrity photos, no AI video. Code-rendered films only.
locked.video: 1080x1920, H.264 + AAC, about -14 LUFS. Uploaded files under 20 MB (jsDelivr limit).
locked.gates: Reviewer PASS before scheduling. validate_media on every URL. Never double-book a slot.
locked.ask_jazzy: Anything involving money, renaming the handle, or a topic near the never-list. (Content type/niche: Claude decides, per Jazzy Nov 3.)
